limitations: This deterministic static suite verifies stable named prompt invariants and lifecycle markers. It does not execute an LLM or prove stochastic task behavior; representative model/runtime trials remain separate evidence.

must_contain: - reserved_lane_non_interference
Do not claim or edit reserved implementation paths
do not create competing tasks or PRs
- separate_feature_ownership
do not combine all three features into one PR
- reuse_held_consumer
Do not duplicate its paths
Reuse or take it over only when live ownership permits.
- no_synthetic_product_lane
Missing durable ownership is a reportable state, not permission to race another lane.
- live_state_refresh
Resolve current `main`, active tasks, branches, PRs, reviews, checks, ownership, leases and programme barriers.
- unknown_producer_semantics_block_runtime
Preserve `UNKNOWN` while producer semantics are unavailable.
No runtime implementation starts while a material game-owned contract remains unknown.
- canonical_selector_barrier
canonical Portal Completion selector is rerun at the barrier
refresh assumptions after each authorized integration
- external_repository_requires_exact_authority
Do not access another server/game repository without separate exact authority.
- retrieved_evidence_not_producer_truth
A source archive is reference evidence, not native gameplay authority.
- partial_consumer_not_complete_feature
Consumer-only work says `partial_consumer`; it does not claim a complete feature.
